title: Controlplane cohort handoff - 2026-11-20
content:
Context:
Quick sync for the cross-cohort handoff between Controlplane (routing + auth + quotas) and Oncall/Platform-ops. Focus: known regressions from the last canary, quota enforcement changes, and auth token rotation timeline. Note: this is a working handoff doc — takeaways, open questions, and the checklist at the bottom are the key bits for the incoming cohort.

Attendees:
- Maya Chen (owner, note taker)
- Anika Rao (routing)
- Diego Morales (auth)
- Evan Patel (quotas)
- Lena Fischer (oncall liaison)
- Samir Gupta (SRE)

High-level updates (by area):
1) Routing (Anika)
- Canary v3 rolled through 3 clusters yesterday (eu-west-1 + us-west-2 + ap-southeast-1).
- Observed: small p95 regression for short (<=64 token) requests: baseline p95 48ms -> canary p95 62ms. Throughput unchanged.
- Hypothesis: kernel selection fallback is triggering extra memcpy on small sequences for a subset of models.
- Action: Anika to run targeted perf profile on node images used by the canary and submit a minimal repro job (ENG-3211).
- Temporary mitigation: routing policy set to prefer nodes with "fast-kernel" label for short-seq routes. This reduces the p95 to ~52ms but increases token cost by ~2% for those requests.
- NOTE TO INCOMING COHORT: watch token-cost dashboards and consumer teams for complaints — metric to follow: route.shortseq.p95 and route.shortseq.unit_cost_delta.

2) Auth (Diego)
- Token rotation RFC accepted; rollout window scheduled next Tue 2026-11-24 02:00-06:00 UTC (low usage window).
- Identified corner case: refresh token race on multiplexed connections; manifests as 401 bursts followed by retries.
- Fix: add jitter to refresh and bump auth library to 1.14.2 (PR link in linked_artifacts). Diego to coordinate with SDK owners (devx) for backcompat.
- Post-rotation test plan: synthetic calls with parallel refreshers (1000 connections) + confirm no elevated 5xx on controlplane auth proxy.

3) Quotas (Evan)
- Automated quota throttles enabled for one pilot customer; initial behavior looked good but we hit an unexpected churn when quota reclamation delay = 30s.
- Symptom: customers with bursty traffic see a quick series of short-lived throttles and then sustained latency as requests backpressure upstream.
- Proposed change: reduce reclamation delay to 8s and add smoothing window to quota signal aggregator.
- Evan to open follow-up ticket with metrics (ENG-3240) and coordinate a staged rollout (pilot -> 5 customers -> broader).

Incidents / follow-ups:
- Incident from 2026-11-17 (brief auth proxy thrash): root cause traced to stale cert rotation config on one controlplane pool. Postmortem draft is in Confluence; next step is to add an automated validation job for cert propagation (Samir).
- Minor outage during canary (routing) that caused increased tail latency for the embeddings route. Follow up: check the allocator's padding heuristics (Anika + Samir).

Decisions made in this meeting:
- Proceed with auth token rotation next Tue with the agreed test window.
- Reduce quota reclamation delay to 8s for pilot customers; monitor backpressure metrics for 48h post-change.
- Keep the temporary routing label policy in place until perf profile confirmed. If profile shows kernel fallback as root cause, schedule hotfix for kernel selection path.

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should we expose the routing label override to internal customers for debugging? (pros: faster triage; cons: potential misuse).
- Long-term: do we want a separate microservice to handle short-sequence routing decisions to avoid on-node kernel decision cost? Needs design spike.
- Quotas: do we introduce per-customer smoothing presets or keep a global smoothing parameter? Evan to prototype.

Handoff checklist (what incoming cohort should do first 24–72h):
- Verify the canary cluster health dashboards and confirm route.shortseq.p95 and embeddings.route.p95 are stable. (Anika -> tests + Samir -> infra health checks)
- Run Diego's auth rotation dry-run in staging using the parallel refresher harness. Confirm 401 spike doesn't occur; otherwise rollback plan must be ready.
- Deploy quota reclamation delta (8s) to pilot and monitor quota.throttle_rate and upstream.latency for 48h. (Evan)
- Ensure the cert-propagation validator job is scheduled on the maintenance pipeline. (Samir)
- Update oncall runbook with the new shortseq routing label fallback steps and temporary mitigation toggles. (Lena)

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Anika: perf profile for small-seq kernel fallback; reproduce and open PR if needed. ETA 2026-11-25.
- Diego: coordinate SDK bump + run rotation dry-run in staging. ETA 2026-11-23.
- Evan: quota reclamation change rollout to pilot + metrics dashboard. ETA 2026-11-22 for pilot flip.
- Samir: cert propagation validator job + postmortem update. ETA 2026-11-24.
- Lena: update oncall runbook and share quick-reference checklist in #platform-controlplane. ETA 2026-11-21.

Notes to self / informal observations (scratchpad):
- We keep getting small tail blips for embeddings route around 3:10-3:20 UTC — correlate with backup windows? Might be noisy because of cross-region snapshotting.
- Customer reports (from CS): two teams saw cost delta after routing label policy — need to proactively message them if change persists.
- Remember to coordinate with Private Deployments team before making any routing label changes that flow into the private controlplane images.

Next sync:
- Quick check-in next Monday 2026-11-23 10:00 PT (standup style) to confirm canary and pilot states. Full handoff review on Wednesday 2026-11-25 9:00 PT if any major outstanding items.

Attachments / references:
- See linked_artifacts above for PR and Confluence.

Raw notes end.

-- Maya
